dz: 在拜占庭皇帝迈克尔·克·卡拉法特斯试图废黜他妻子并镇压佐伊·波菲罗金塔后,君士坦丁堡爆发了一场民众起义,意图使她复原.
de: Following the attempt of Byzantine Emperor Michael V Kalaphates to depose his wife and empress Zoe Porphyrogenita, a popular uprising in Constantinople breaks out with the intention to restore her.

t: 忏悔者爱德华成为英格兰国王——该国倒数第二位盎格鲁撒克逊国王。
te: Edward the Confessor becomes King of England – the country's penultimate Anglo-Saxon king.
dz: 忏悔者爱德华成为英格兰国王——该国倒数第二位盎格鲁撒克逊国王。
de: Edward the Confessor becomes King of England – the country's penultimate Anglo-Saxon king.

t: 佐伊·波弗罗金塔皇后嫁给了君士坦丁·莫诺马乔斯,次日被加冕为拜占庭皇帝.
te: Empress Zoe Porphyrogenita marries Constantine Monomachos, who is crowned the following day as Byzantine Emperor.
dz: 佐伊·波弗罗金塔皇后嫁给了君士坦丁·莫诺马乔斯,次日被加冕为拜占庭皇帝.
de: Empress Zoe Porphyrogenita marries Constantine Monomachos, who is crowned the following day as Byzantine Emperor.

t: 君士坦丁九世莫诺马霍斯在与佐伊·波菲罗根尼塔皇后结婚一天后加冕为拜占庭皇帝。
te: Constantine IX Monomachos is crowned as Byzantine Emperor, one day after his marriage to Empress Zoe Porphyrogenita.
dz: 君士坦丁九世莫诺马霍斯在与佐伊·波菲罗根尼塔皇后结婚一天后加冕为拜占庭皇帝。
